name: Surface or layer code
description: Code specifying the surface or layer of an object.

values.name: Side one
values.description: Side one The location is side one.

values.name: Side two
values.description: Side two The location is side two.

values.name: On surface
values.description: On surface To indicate that the entity being specified is on the surface.

values.name: Off surface
values.description: Off surface To indicate that the entity being specified is off the surface.

values.name: Soluble
values.description: Soluble Specifies that the surface/layer/position being described is the soluble portion.

values.name: Opposite corners
values.description: Opposite corners The surface or layer of the product being described is the opposite corners.

values.name: Corner Diagonals
values.description: Corner Diagonals The surface or layer of the product being described are the corner diagonals.

values.name: Port
values.description: Port The left-hand side (looking forward) of a ship, boat or aircraft.

values.name: Starboard
values.description: Starboard The right-hand side (looking forward) of a ship, boat or aircraft.

values.name: Tooth facial surface
values.description: Tooth facial surface Surface of a tooth directed toward the face and opposite the lingual surface.

values.name: Tooth incisal surface
values.description: Tooth incisal surface Surface of the tooth relating to the cutting edge of the anterior teeth, incisors or canines.

values.name: Tooth distal surface
values.description: Tooth distal surface Surface of the tooth toward the back of the dental arch, or away from the midline.

values.name: Tooth buccal surface
values.description: Tooth buccal surface Surface of the tooth pertaining to or around the cheek.

values.name: Tooth occlusal surface
values.description: Tooth occlusal surface Surface of the tooth pertaining to the masticating surfaces of the posterior teeth.

values.name: Tooth lingual surface
values.description: Tooth lingual surface Surface of the tooth pertaining to or around the tongue.

values.name: Tooth mesial surface
values.description: Tooth mesial surface Surface of the tooth toward the midline of the dental arch.

values.name: Back of cab
values.description: Back of cab The location is at the back of the cab.

values.name: Both sides

values.name: Bottom

values.name: Dual fuel tank positions
values.description: Dual fuel tank positions The location is in the dual fuel tank positions.

values.name: Inside

values.name: Left
values.description: Left The location is on the left.

values.name: Overall

values.name: One side

values.name: Outside

values.name: Right

values.name: Rear

values.name: Spare tyre position

values.name: Tank bottom
